subject: Demo partner sweetener — special credit & packaging ask
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@finnlabs.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: FinnLabs Partnerships <partners@finnlabs.io>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner demo credit — request for flexibility

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — excited about how Redwood could power realtime features for our demo flow. A quick ask from our side: we run a curated demo partner program next month and would like to offer participating startups an additional usage "sweetener" (one-off free credits) to encourage joint public demos.

Questions:
- Can Redwood make a one-time promotional credit issuance tied to our partner cohort (20 startups)?
- If some of those startups convert to Dedicated, can the promo credits be applied toward a Dedicated commit/credit conversion, or must they be used only on hosted?
- Are there limits on stacking this with existing accelerator credits?

I attached a short one-pager on the program and estimated usage. Happy to jump on a call to discuss specifics — we need to finalize the offer by next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Partnerships, FinnLabs

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@finnlabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner demo credit — request for flexibility

Hi Alex — appreciate the details and the timeline. Short answer: we can usually support cohort promo credits, but there are a few constraints on conversion and stacking that I'll confirm with ops/legal.

Before I give a concrete proposal, can you confirm:
- Expected average monthly usage per startup during demo period (approx tokens / embeddings)?
- Do the startups already have any Redwood promo credits (e.g., from accelerators or previous pilots)?
- Will FinnLabs require the credits to be transferable between team members or tied to a single account?

Ben/Marissa — looping you both in for ops/rules. If we can get comfortable with conversion rules (apply-to-dedicated policy) and a simple MA, I'm inclined to offer a modest cohort allocation + a per-conversion grace (see notes below).

I'll aim to come back with a suggested packaging and approval path today.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Re: Partner demo credit — request for flexibility

Avery — quick ops perspective. Key constraints and a proposed path: 

Constraints:
- Promo credits on hosted are straightforward.
- Applying promo credits directly to Dedicated commits requires an accounting carveout (we treat reserved capacity discounts differently).
- Stacking: accelerator credits (company-provided) should be honored first; partner-sponsored promo credits can be additive but we need to cap total promotional uplift to avoid revenue leakage.

Proposal:
- Offer: 20x demo sweeteners = $1,000 hosted credits each (3-month expiry).
- Conversion allowance: If a startup converts to Dedicated within 90 days, allow a one-time credit transfer up to $600 applied as a prepayment credit toward the first month of Dedicated commit (not as a recurring discount). Finance needs the $600 cap in the contract.
- Stacking rule: Promo credits will apply after accelerator credits are consumed.
- Ops/Legal: require a short MA signed by FinnLabs and startups (MA template attached).

Attachments: proposed_MA_plan.pdf — includes milestone gating, allowed reuse, and tracking fields.

If you want to be more generous on the conversion cap we can escalate, but this should be approvable by Revenue Ops and Finance without exec sign-off.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Growth Programs | Redwood Inference
--- attachment: proposed_MA_plan.pdf (application/pdf, 95KB)
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex@finnlabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 17:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner demo credit — request for flexibility

Alex — thanks for the one-pager and for being flexible. We ran this by Ops and Finance; here's what Redwood can provide: 

Offer summary (final):
- Cohort sweetener: 20 x $1,000 hosted promo credits, valid for 90 days from issuance.
- Conversion allowance: If a participating startup signs a Dedicated commit within 90 days, we will permit a one-time transfer of up to $600 of the promo credit toward the first month's Dedicated prepayment (applied as a one-time bill credit). This is a conversion cap, not a recurring discount.
- Stacking: Any existing accelerator/partner credits will be used first; FinnLabs-supplied promo credits will be consumed after.
- Tracking & MA: We require a simple MA signed by FinnLabs and participating startups to confirm eligibility and demo delivery. I've attached the MA template and a DocuSign link for signature.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm estimated per-startup demo usage (tokens/embedding volume) so we can provision capacity.
2) Sign the MA (DocuSign link below) and provide the list of participating startup account emails.
3) Once we receive the signed MA and participant list we'll issue credits within 2 business days.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/MA/FinnLabs-2026 (link expires in 14 days)
Drive copy of MA template: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/FinnLabs/onepager

If you need a higher conversion cap or longer expiry we'll need a short business justification and an approval from my manager — happy to help escalate if FinnLabs wants a bigger sweetener.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
